summary.text: Molly Donahue is a Democratic Iowa state senator who has represented District 37 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A teacher, she previously served in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023.

paragraphs.text: Molly Donahue was born in Cedar Rapids, Iowa, and graduated from Washington High School there.

She earned a bachelor's degree in elementary education and teaching from Iowa State University in 1989, a master's degree in secondary behavior disabilities from the University of Northern Iowa in 1996, and an associate degree in secondary school administration from the University of Northern Iowa in 2000.
Her career experience includes working as a behavior specialist and teacher with the Cedar Rapids Community School District.
Donahue represented District 68 in the Iowa House of Representatives from 2019 to 2023 and assumed office in the Iowa State Senate on January 3, 2023.

According to Ballotpedia, her 2016 campaign website said that, as a state representative, she would work to fully fund Iowa's public schools, raise the minimum wage and make child care more affordable.
